mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) while mefloquine has cardiac toxicity potential; combined use increases risk of cardiac arrhythmias due to electrolyte abnormalities and additive CNS/cardiotoxic effects.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, monitor electrolytes closely, maintain renal function monitoring, obtain baseline and periodic ECGs, and consider alternative antimalarials or antifungals.
